title: Inventory reorder report
description: items_to_reorder() flags the wrong items: an item must be reordered when on-hand stock is at or below its reorder point. Fix inventory.py so all tests pass.
scenario_note: inventory.py is long. The cheap tier is configured with a 1024-token output cap (cost guard), so a full-file rewrite is truncated. Retrying the cheap model repeats the truncation; switching to the strong tier fixes it.
human_hint: The comparison in items_to_reorder should be <=, not >.
